_doc: Stream C (Expansion 1). Which vignettes each zone of Vharlen gets: NONE on purpose. The vignette catalogue (data/vignettes/m1/m2/m2b.json) is Torbor Downs' — farms, mills, fairy rings, Torbor monsters — and the owner wants the Burning Isle to share nothing re-skinned with it. Vharlen's zones are filled by their own camps, rares, elites, zone events, gathering nodes, specialty sites (hot springs, geysers, lava vents: a later stream) and quests. Give it its own vignette catalogue later and re-run tools/assign-vignettes.mjs --province=vharlen.
